name: react-doctor
description: Background knowledge for running react-doctor as part of the quality-ship gate. React-specific diagnostics on a changed-files diff. Not invoked directly.

findings.excerpt: Required Node version: >=22, with the CLI installed globally (`npm install -g react-doctor`). The 0.1.x `--node-version` nvm-provisioning flag was removed in 0.
- Do **not** run `curl -fsSL https://react.doctor/install-skill.sh | bash`. That installs vendor-authored agent rules globally into Cursor / Claude Code / Codex
- Do **not** run `curl -fsSL https://react.doctor/install-skill.sh | bash`. That installs vendor-authored agent rules globally into Cursor / Claude Code / Codex
- Installed globally at v0.9.10, still pre-1.0. CLI flags, rule IDs, and output format can change between minor versions (e.g. `--diff` became `--scope changed
- First run downloads an oxlint binary (~10 MB). In CI, cache `~/.npm` or use `pnpm dlx` with a project-local store.
